package.name: zed_opencv_calibration
package.description: ZED fisheye stereo calibration and reprojection viewer tools. Plain CMake package (no ament) so colcon discovers and builds the zed_stereo_calibration and zed_reprojection_viewer executables. Adopted from https://github.com/stereolabs/zed-opencv-calibration with Cargo-maintained local patches (see README.md).
